raw_segments.text: This I would not hear of, so he took the top, and I faced him.
It was a nice little dinner, seemed to me then a very Lord Mayor's feast, and it acquired
additional relish from being eaten under those independent circumstances, with no old people
by and with London all around us.
This again was heightened by a certain gypsy character that set the banquet off, for while
the table was, as Mr. Pumblechook might have said, the lap of luxury, being entirely furnished
forth from the coffee-house, the circumjacent region of sitting-room was of a comparatively
pastureless and shifty character, imposing on the waiter the wandering habits of putting
the covers on the floor, where he fell over them, the melted butter in the arm-chair,
the bread on the bookshelves, the cheese in the coal-scuttle, and the boiled fowl into
my bed in the next room, where I found much of its parsley and butter in a state of conulation
when I retired for the night.
